item: 3.7 follow-up — a denial the card sent comes back as the tool's error result; the tool line keeps its red dot but draws no OUT box repeating the note (2026-09-05)
branch: done() records every deny message a card sends (the trimmed note, or LIM.rejectMessage when empty) in cardDenies; onUserEvent's tool_result path returns after the run/fail classes when an is_error result's text is one of them, so no OUT box is built. A different error text still draws its box. Counted as OUT rows: a Bash line always has its IN row, so the box under test is the row whose key reads OUT.
provenance: The result shape is the CLI's: the deny message is delivered VERBATIM as the tool_result with is_error:true and toolDenialKind on the record (probed 2.1.233; seen again in the user's 2026-09-05 transcript e5d6aaf2…, content "Ignore please."). stream_event tool_use frames copied from fixture 07. The harness has no mid-frame JS hook, so each deny case is two steps: the card goes up, then the next step's setup clicks Reject before the result frame arrives. Negative control on the 3.7 build without this fix: steps 1 and 3 draw an OUT box (io-row count 1) — DISCRIMINATING; step 2's box for a foreign error is a GUARD that passes on both builds.
